map.常见宝石与矿物莫氏硬度(Mohs)对照表，列明硬度等级、耐久性与佩戴保养建议，选: Mohs hardness comparison table for common gemstones and minerals, listing hardness grade, durability and wearing/care advice, as a reference for preventing scratches when choosing and wearing jewellery daily.
map.按莫氏硬度判断宝石耐刮与佩戴场景。: Judge a gemstone's scratch resistance and wearing scenarios by Mohs hardness.
map.避免硬物混放互相刮花。: Avoid storing hard objects together so they scratch each other.
map.：钻石 10、红蓝宝(刚玉) 9、托帕石 8–8.5、石英 7–7.5、珍珠/珊: : Diamond 10, ruby and sapphire (corundum) 9, topaz 8-8.5, quartz 7-7.5, pearl/coral about 3-4 (organic gems are soft). A hardness difference of at least 2 grades is needed before they noticeably scratch each other.
map.为什么珍珠要单放: Why should pearls be stored separately?
map.：珍珠硬度仅 3–4，与金属或硬石同盒会被划伤；应软布分隔存放，远离 7 级以上: : Pearls have a hardness of only 3-4 and are scratched if boxed with metal or hard stones; store them separated by soft cloth and away from gemstones of grade 7 and above.
map.不是等比。10 级是 ordinal 排序，钻石(10)远超刚玉(9)的差距远大: No, it is not a geometric progression. Grade 10 is an ordinal ranking; the gap from corundum (9) to diamond (10) is far larger than that between 9 and 8, and it only indicates whether one can scratch the other.
